modalities.label: Voice call
modalities.main: User role, wrapped as untrusted with a do-not-follow note.
modalities.pr: User role, 'actor: text' prefix, no wrapping or sanitizing.
modalities.risk: Caller instructions now look like user commands, including payment requests.

modalities.label: Seller chat
modalities.main: User role, wrapped as untrusted with a do-not-follow note.
modalities.pr: User role, 'actor: text' prefix, no wrapping or sanitizing.
modalities.risk: Seller text is indistinguishable from user instructions during negotiation.

modalities.label: Listing text
modalities.main: User role, 'Listing from actor:' prefix, unwrapped and unsanitized.
modalities.pr: User role, regex-filtered lines, wrapped as untrusted data.
modalities.risk: Keyword regex is bypassable by paraphrase and drops legitimate lines.

modalities.label: User request
modalities.main: Raw text as a user role message.
modalities.pr: Raw text as a user role message.

capabilities.name: listing intake
capabilities.why: Listing text now goes through sanitize(), which drops regex-matched lines and wraps the rest via wrap_untrusted.

capabilities.name: call handling
capabilities.why: The call channel lost wrap_untrusted and now reaches the model as a bare 'actor: text' user message.

capabilities.name: seller messages
capabilities.why: The seller channel lost wrap_untrusted and now reaches the model as a bare 'actor: text' user message.

capabilities.name: input trust
capabilities.why: UNTRUSTED_CHANNELS was deleted, so only listings are marked untrusted and callers and sellers get user-level framing.

capabilities.name: payments
capabilities.why: send_payment code is unchanged, but unwrapped call and seller text can now steer it.

capabilities.name: budget enforcement
capabilities.why: The diff contains no budget logic changes.

capabilities.name: merchant allowlist
capabilities.why: The diff contains no allowlist code.

capabilities.name: memory
capabilities.why: The diff does not touch memory or persistence.
